item.description: ### Added - **Quick Screenshot (`⌃ ⌥ ⌘ 5`)** — capture any area or window into a floating editor with per-tool remembered defaults, arrows, shapes, spotlights, customizable text pills, numbered badges, crop, Beautify gradient frames, Pin on Screen, pinch/scroll zoom, and one-click copy, save, or share - **On-Device Auto-Redact & OCR** — detect and redact API keys, secret files, recovery codes, emails, and cards 100% locally with Apple Vision and a review tray, choose Pixelate, Blur, Solid, or Smart Erase (permanently flattened on export), or copy extracted text in one click - **Keyboard Shortcuts Hub & Caps Lock Hyper Key** — browse, search, test, and resolve conflicts across every Toolbox shortcut in one dedicated sidebar view (with a Visual Key Map and Press-Key-to-Find), and optionally turn Caps Lock into a dual-role Hyper Key - **Window Switcher (`⌥ Tab`)** — cycle through individual open, minimized, and hidden-app windows in a `⌘ Tab`-style horizontal thumbnail strip or compact list with `/` type-to-filter and instant Close (`W`), Minimize (`M`), Hide (`H`), and Quit (`Q`) actions
